correctness.rationale: A shortest cube path flips distinct bits; a missing bit extends it, so maximal paths are exactly diameter geodesics with d+1 vertices. The elementary floor/ceiling volume bounds follow. The independent checker reconstructs Q4 from all five-vertex subsets with connected induced path and antipodal endpoints, then tests disjoint pairs and triples: 192 paths up to reversal, 31 disjoint from the canonical path, 2976 pairs and zero triples. This exhausts the path sets, since a shortest path in the cube is induced and its vertex set determines it up to reversal. The check separately validates the stated Q4/Q5/Q6 paths and uncovered sets {8,9,10,11,12,14}, {10,19}, {47}; the extra Q6 path includes 47 and completes the ten-path cover. The Q1–Q3 bounds are attained, including the two explicit Q3 paths.
